arxiv-2201-01591.title: On the finiteness of the second moment of the number of critical points of Gaussian random fields
arxiv-2201-01591.creator: Samuel Davenport, Fabian J.E. Telschow, [5mm] Division of Biostatistics, University of California, San Diego
arxiv-2201-01591.description: Abstract We prove that the second moment of the number of critical points of any sufficiently regular random field, for example with almost surely C 3 C^{3} sample paths, defined over a compact Whitney stratified manifold is finite. Our results hold without the assumption of stationarity - which has traditionally been assumed in other work.

arxiv-2202-05383.title: Including Facial Expressions in Contextual Embeddings for Sign Language Generation
arxiv-2202-05383.creator: Carla Viegas, Mert Inan, Lorna Quandt, Malihe Alikhani
arxiv-2202-05383.description: Abstract State-of-the-art sign language generation frameworks lack expressivity and naturalness which is the result of only focusing manual signs, neglecting the affective, grammatical and semantic functions of facial expressions. The purpose of this work is to augment semantic representation of sign language through grounding facial expressions.

arxiv-2205-05173.title: Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection: A Survey and Outlook Journal: Neural Networks
arxiv-2205-05173.creator: Hadi Hojjati, Thi Kieu Khanh Ho †, Naregs Armanfard
arxiv-2205-05173.description: Abstract Anomaly detection (AD) plays a crucial role in various domains, including cybersecurity, finance, and healthcare, by identifying patterns or events that deviate from normal behaviour. In recent years, significant progress has been made in this field due to the remarkable growth of deep learning models.

arxiv-2401-17600.title: Good at captioning, bad at counting: Benchmarking GPT-4V on Earth observation data
arxiv-2401-17600.creator: Chenhui Zhang, Sherrie Wang
arxiv-2401-17600.description: Abstract Large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance on complex tasks involving visual input with natural language instructions. However, it remains unclear to what extent capabilities on natural images transfer to Earth observation (EO) data, which are predominantly satellite and aerial images less common in VLM training data.

arxiv-2403-02262.title: Dynamics of the collision of two nearly equal solitary waves for the Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation
arxiv-2403-02262.creator: Didier Pilod, Frédéric Valet
arxiv-2403-02262.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Didier Pilod, Frédéric Valet. We study the dynamics of the collision of two solitary waves for the Zakharov-Kuznetsov equation in dimension 2 2 and 3 3 . We describe the evolution of the solution behaving as a sum of 2 2 -solitary waves of nearly equal speeds at time t = − ∞ t=-\infty up to time t = + ∞ t=+\infty .

arxiv-2405-14616.title: TimeMixer: Decomposable Multiscale Mixing for Time Series Forecasting
arxiv-2405-14616.creator: Shiyu Wang, Haixu Wu, Xiaoming Shi, Tengge Hu, Huakun Luo, Lintao Ma, James Y. Zhang, Jun Zhou
arxiv-2405-14616.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shiyu Wang, Haixu Wu, Xiaoming Shi, Tengge Hu, Huakun Luo, Lintao Ma, James Y. Zhang, Jun Zhou. Time series forecasting is widely used in extensive applications, such as traffic planning and weather forecasting. However, real-world time series usually present intricate temporal variations, making forecasting extremely challenging.

arxiv-2408-10327.title: An Empirical Study on Package-Level Deprecation in Python Ecosystem
arxiv-2408-10327.creator: Zhiqing Zhong 2 , Shilin He 5 1 , Haoxuan Wang 2 , Boxi Yu 2 , Haowen Yang 2 , Pinjia He 2 1
arxiv-2408-10327.description: Abstract Open-source software (OSS) plays a crucial role in modern software development. Utilizing OSS code can greatly accelerate software development, reduce redundancy, and enhance reliability. Python, a widely adopted programming language, is renowned for its extensive and diverse third-party package ecosystem.

arxiv-2408-15276.title: A Survey of Deep Learning for Group-level Emotion Recognition
arxiv-2408-15276.creator: Xiaohua Huang, Jinke Xu, Wenming Zheng, Qirong Mao, Abhinav Dhall
arxiv-2408-15276.description: Abstract With the advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, group-level emotion recognition (GER) has emerged as an important area in analyzing human behavior. Early GER methods are primarily relied on handcrafted features. However, with the proliferation of Deep Learning (DL) techniques and their remarkable success in diverse tasks, neural networks have garnered increasing interest in GER.

britannica-1911-anthrax.description: Article 'Anthrax' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 2), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Animals.—As affecting wild as well as domesticated animals and man, anthrax has been widely diffused in one or more of its forms, over the surface of the globe. It at times decimates the reindeer herds in Lapland and the Polar regions, and is only too well known in the tropics and in temperate latitudes.

pmc-10710528.creator: Harkesh Arora, Anna Bode, Sreekant Avula, Roopa Naik, Sujith Palleti, Deepak Chandramohan

pmc-11359188.title: The Generation of Attenuated Mutants of East Asian Passiflora Virus via Deletion and Mutation in the N-Terminal Region of the HC-Pro Gene for Control through Cross-Protection
pmc-11359188.creator: Duy-Hung Do, Xuan-Tung Ngo, Shyi-Dong Yeh
pmc-11359188.description: East Asian Passiflora virus (EAPV) causes passionfruit woodiness disease, a major threat limiting passionfruit production in eastern Asia, including Taiwan and Vietnam. In this study, an infectious cDNA clone of a Taiwanese severe isolate EAPV-TW was tagged with a green fluorescent protein (GFP) reporter to monitor the virus in plants.

pmc-11634076.title: Epidemiological investigation of sex hormones and their metabolism-related gene single nucleotide polymorphisms in patients with benign prostatic hyperplasia complicated with late-onset hypogonadism: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11634076.creator: Bengen Li, Congcong Chen, Zongping Chen, Qixu Ren, Ningrui Pan, Xu He, Min Wang, Xiaoyu Ai, Youzhuang Zhong, You Xiang, Bo Chen, Jiawei Sun, Yu Cao, Zhengdong Ouyang
pmc-11634076.description: Background:Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) is a common disease in middle-aged and elderly men, and its etiology is not completely clear. Late-onset hypogonadism (LOH) is a relatively common disease in the aging process of men. BPH is often accompanied by varying degrees of LOH, and the pathogenesis and progression of the two diseases are related.

pmc-12591776.title: Artificial pleural effusion-assisted intraoperative ultrasound for the localization of pulmonary tumors during video-assisted thoracic surgery
pmc-12591776.creator: Yali Qu, Xiaojing Lin, Lei Li, Wenjuan Xu, Jun Xu, Bingxin Lei, Jie Tu, Muqin Tu, Mi Zhou, Hongchang Luo
pmc-12591776.description: BackgroundIntraoperative localization of pulmonary nodules (PNs) is a technical support for video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS). Failure to accurately localize PNs will necessitate conversion to conventional open chest surgery or transfer to the hybrid operation room, which highlights the importance of intraoperative ultrasound (IOUS) for identifying lesions.

pmc-12697483.creator: Somlina Roy, Rubina Dohare, Alluri Rajyalaxmi, Sachin Parmar
pmc-12697483.description: SARS-CoV-2 infection among pregnant females is of concern. Therefore, it is of interest to evaluate the demographic characteristics, clinical profiles and outcomes of pregnant women with COVID-19 during two pandemic waves. An ambi-directional observational study was conducted at Gandhi Medical College, Bhopal, over 18 months (Jan 2021-Jun 2022), including 210 COVID-19-positive pregnant women.

pmc-12843831.title: Long-Lasting Hydrophilicity of Al2O3 Surfaces via Femtosecond Laser Microprocessing
pmc-12843831.creator: Alessandra Signorile, Liliana Papa, Marida Pontrandolfi, Caterina Gaudiuso, Annalisa Volpe, Antonio Ancona, Francesco Paolo Mezzapesa
pmc-12843831.description: We explore the wettability modulation induced on alumina (Al2O3) targets by femtosecond laser texturing to demonstrate the stable and durable hydrophilic character of the surface. Specifically, we identify a suitable operational regime to tailor micro-nanostructures onto Al2O3 plates and accurately assess the ablation threshold in our experimental conditions.

pmc-13061522.title: Flow-Through Lateral Arm Flap With Vein Grafting for Repairing Circumferential Thumb Soft-Tissue and Segmental Vascular Defects
pmc-13061522.creator: Rui Liu, Yongbing Xiao
pmc-13061522.description: Background:Circumferential soft-tissue loss of the thumb and vascular defects are among the most challenging problems in microsurgical reconstruction.Methods:We present the case of a 15-year-old male patient who sustained a thermal crush injury to the thumb, resulting in complete circumferential loss of skin and soft tissue with segmental defects of both the proper digital arteries and veins.

pmc-13066404.title: Beyond RBD: covert REM sleep abnormalities in Parkinson’s disease
pmc-13066404.creator: Saar Lanir-Azaria, Yuval Nir, Riva Tauman, Jennifer Zitser, Nir Giladi
pmc-13066404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). REM sleep behavior disorder (RBD), involving REM sleep without atonia (RSWA), is a prodromal marker of Parkinson’s disease (PD). We investigated whether RBD may represent the “tip of the iceberg” of pathology driving wider REM sleep disruptions. In this study, 25 early-stage, drug-naïve PD patients and 23 age-matched healthy controls underwent overnight polysomnography with high-density EEG (256 channels) to assess how sleep patterns relate to generalized motor learning (GML).

pmc-13098535.title: Retinal Microvascular Dysfunction Reflects Vascular and Alzheimer's‐Related Pathology in Dementia With Lewy Bodies
pmc-13098535.creator: Qiuling Tong, William Robert Kwapong, Xiaoqian Luan, Suqing Hu, Yihan Hu, Yimo Guo, Chenli Ji, Ming Yang, Zhen Wang
pmc-13098535.description: BackgroundDementia with Lewy bodies (DLB) frequently coexists with cerebrovascular injury and Alzheimer's‐related pathology, yet accessible in vivo markers of these processes remain limited. The retinal microvasculature shares structural and physiological characteristics with cerebral small vessels and may provide a non‐invasive window into neurovascular and neurodegenerative pathology.

pmc-13377829.title: A positive feedback loop between BACH1 and IL-1β promotes the progression of HPV-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-13377829.creator: Zishanbai Zhang, Miao Wang, Wenjuan Wang, Minghui Zhao, Yiming Ding, Tingyao Ma, Zhaohan Zhang, Xilin Wang, Yuchen Xiang, Yaning Wang, Wenying Zhong, Zicheng Wu, Yiran Meng, Xiaohong Chen, Lin Shan
pmc-13377829.description: Human papillomavirus (HPV)-negative head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is associated with a poorer prognosis compared to its HPV-positive counterpart; however, the underlying regulatory molecular mechanisms driving its progression remain poorly understood. In this study, we identify BTB Domain and CNC Homolog 1 (BACH1) as a critical oncogenic regulator that is upregulated in HPV-negative HNSCC.

uslaw-usc-t10-s688a.title: 10 U.S.C. § 688a — Authority to order to active duty in high-demand, low-density assignments
uslaw-usc-t10-s688a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s688a.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 39 (Active Duty). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority.— The Secretary of a military department may order to active duty a retired member who agrees to serve on active duty in an assignment intended to alleviate a high-demand, low-density military capability or in any other specialty designated by the Secretary.
